entities.summary: The Mirza Ahmed Mosque is a former mosque, located in the Icherisheher of Baku, the capital of Azerbaijan. Completed in 1345, and built by Haji Mirza Ahmed, the former mosque is situated on the Mirza Alakbar Sabir Street, in a row with residential buildings.
